body.type: Naturally full, soft feminine hourglass figure with healthy curves
body.build: Soft, curvaceous and balanced – emphasizes natural feminine fullness over athletic definition. The body shows a healthy layer of softness that looks realistic and relatable.

body.chest: Naturally full and rounded, well-proportioned to her shoulders and hips.
body.waist: Naturally slim with a soft, gentle curve (approx. 65-68cm). Noticeable waist-to-hip transition with a slight, natural softness around the lower midsection (no visible abs).
body.hips: Widely rounded and full, creating a clear hourglass silhouette. High-set hips that flow smoothly into shapely thighs.
body.legs: Shapely and full; thighs are naturally rounded and firm but soft to the touch, tapering down to elegant calves. Smooth skin with no visible muscle separation.
body.arms: Slender but soft, maintaining a graceful feminine line without gym-induced muscle tone.
body.skin_texture: Warm light-medium tan, golden undertone, natural healthy glow with realistic skin texture.
body.overall_aesthetic: Healthy, soft-curvy Vietnamese aesthetic. It captures the 'girl-next-door' vibe who is active but retains her natural feminine plumpness and soft edges.
